limits: This is a local source review, not actual timer business validation.
Actual expiry, scheduler cancellation, reminders and audio remain outside this core controller review.
reviewed_behavior: The first exception cleanup entry creates one absolute cleanup_until. The successful-work final path creates it only if still None. Finally never grants a second 35-second lease.

Final close is preceded by an explicit remaining-time check and the signal is armed only for the remaining absolute budget. Flow.cleanup uses min(cleanup_until - 5, now + 30), retaining time for close/readback without extending the boundary.
If the absolute boundary is exhausted, the outer failure path retains FAILED/business_success_verified false and pending/owned state. The added owned_task_remaining is reporting only.
Only cleanup and execute ASTs changed. Existing native/timer-effect/close pending fences, exact owned ID and acknowledged readback behavior from the earlier review are unchanged.
